def solve(case):
    payload = case.get("payload")
    if payload is None:
        raise ValueError("Missing payload")
    round_scores = payload.get("round_scores")
    round_targets = payload.get("round_targets")
    forced = payload.get("forced")
    if not (isinstance(round_scores, list) and isinstance(round_targets, list) and isinstance(forced, list)):
        raise ValueError("Invalid payload structure")
    # Validate lengths
    if not round_scores:
        raise ValueError("Empty round_scores")
    n_rounds = len(round_scores)
    if len(round_targets) != n_rounds:
        raise ValueError("Mismatch between round_scores and round_targets lengths")
    # Validate each round scores
    lengths = [len(scores) for scores in round_scores]
    if not all(l == lengths[0] for l in lengths):
        raise ValueError("Inconsistent score lengths across rounds")
    n_tokens = lengths[0]
    if n_tokens == 0:
        raise ValueError("No tokens")
    # Validate forced indices
    for f in forced:
        if not isinstance(f, int) or f < 0 or f >= n_tokens:
            raise ValueError(f"Forced index {f} out of range")
    # Check for duplicates in forced
    if len(set(forced)) != len(forced):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate forced indices")
    # Initialize active indices
    active = list(range(n_tokens))
    masks = []
    # Iterate rounds
    for r in range(n_rounds):
        scores = round_scores[r]
        target = round_targets[r]
        # Current forced that are still active
        forced_active = [i for i in forced if i in active]
        # Feasibility checks
        if target < len(forced_active):
            raise ValueError(f"Round {r}: target {target} < forced count {len(forced_active)}")
        if target > len(active):
            raise ValueError(f"Round {r}: target {target} > active count {len(active)}")
        # Candidates: active indices not forced
        remaining = [i for i in active if i not in forced_active]
        # Sort remaining by score descending, breaking ties by index ascending
        remaining_sorted = sorted(remaining, key=lambda i: (-scores[i], i))
        # Select top from remaining
        to_add = remaining_sorted[:target - len(forced_active)]
        # Combine forced and selected
        selected = set(forced_active) | set(to_add)
        # Create mask sorted by index
        mask = sorted(selected)
        # Update active
        active = mask
        masks.append(mask)
    final_retained = masks[-1] if masks else []
    return {"masks": masks, "final_retained": final_retained}
